item.description: I am an Assistant Professor at HKU Business School. I received my Ph.D. in Operations Research from Columbia University, where I was advised by Professor Adam Elmachtoub. My research asks how digital platforms can engage users while protecting their welfare. I pursue this agenda through two connected themes: Engaging Users. I study and optimize how platforms use uncertainty, incentives, and prior interactions to shape user engagement and behavior, particularly in gaming and education.
